images.caption:
Detail of a swedish map dated 31 july 1678 showing the damages on the fortress Bohus after the just ended siege.
A and B Holes in the wall caused by explosive charges.
C Severe damage on the bastion Nedre Platt caused by explosive chages.
F Tenaille completely destroyed by explosive charges.
G Holes in the wall caused by cannonfire.
H Danish-norwegian trenches.
Q One of the danish-norwegian cannonbatteries placed on the island Hisingen.

T Danish-norwegian trenches on the island Hisingen.
